[[File:Crafting_Guild_Cows.png|thumb|234px|The cows on the west side of the guild.]]
The '''Crafting Guild''' is located south-west of [[Falador]] and north of [[Rimmington]]. It provides top-notch workshops for accomplished crafters. A [[Crafting]] level of 40 is required to enter the guild as well as wearing one of the following:

*A [[brown apron|brown]] or [[golden apron]]
*A [[Crafting cape]]
*A [[Max cape]] or any of its [[Max cape#Variants|variants]]

These items are '''only required to enter through the door'''. Once inside, they are not required at all.

==Transportation==
In addition to walking to the guild, players may use the following transportation methods:

*A [[skills necklace]], [[Crafting cape]], or [[max cape]] can be used to teleport to the Crafting Guild.
*Players who have unlocked the Crafting Guild [[Balloon Transport System|hot air balloon]] route after completing [[Enlightened Journey]] can take a hot air balloon to just north of the Crafting Guild for a fee of one [[oak log]].
*Players who have their [[player-owned house]] located in Rimmington can walk a short distance north-west to the Crafting Guild. Players with a [[tool store 3]] can pick up a brown apron on their way.

==Features==
===Exterior===
The west side of the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} borders a [[cow]] pen. Entry to the guild is not required to access it. Players can kill the cows and bring the [[cow hide]]s to the tanner on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the guild to have them tanned. Since this is the closest tanner to any cows in the game, this is an ideal location to craft leather goods.

===Ground floor===
When a player enters the guild, they are greeted by one of the three [[Master Crafter]]s walking around, who will tell players about the guild. One of the Master Crafters sells the Crafting [[Cape of Accomplishment]].

The {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} contains 4 [[potter's wheel]]s for making unfired [[clay]] items, a [[pottery oven]] to harden the unfired clay items, a sink, a spiral staircase leading to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}, and various items that respawn on desks and tables, including a [[jug]], a [[chisel]], a [[hammer]], and [[amulet mould|amulet]] and [[bracelet mould]]s.

East of the ground floor is an exit leading to the guild's own outdoor [[Crafting Guild mine|mine]] which contains 7 [[gold rocks]], 6 [[silver rocks]], and 6 [[clay rocks]], the highest concentration available to [[free players]].

==== Bank chest ====
The east side of the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} has a members-only [[Bank|bank chest]] and [[deposit box]]. Only players who have completed the [[hard Falador Diary]] or have level 99 [[Crafting]] will be able to use either. This is considered to be the fastest way to access a bank for players with the [[Crafting cape]].

===Upper floor===
The {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} contains a [[Tanner (Crafting Guild)|tanner]] who can tan [[cow hide]]s and [[dragonhide]] into [[leather]] and [[dragon leather]]. On this floor there are also two [[spinning wheel]]s to spin [[wool]].

There are several items that respawn on tables, including a [[ring mould]], a [[tiara mould]], a [[necklace mould]], and a [[holy mould]], and a pair of [[shears]] which respawns on a barrel.
